resolution.note: stuckInStopLoop keys on the refusal without the per-run log path; regression test through real stopHook trips on the 4th identical failing-test refusal

title: The Stop loop breaker trips on repeated test-failure refusals that differ only in their log path
body:
Evidence: audit 2026-11-20 D3: saveFailureLog embeds ${Date.now()}-${process.pid}.log into the refusal text that stop-loop hashes (src/hook/stop.ts saveFailureLog, src/hook/stop-loop.ts), so four identical refusals count 1 and STOP_LOOP_LIMIT=3 never trips; test/hook/stop-loop-limit.test.ts stubs the refusal text.
Outcome: the stop-loop key ignores the log path; repeated identical test-failure refusals trip the breaker.
Proof: a regression test through the real judgeStop refusal text trips the breaker on the fourth identical refusal.
